name: Build and test
description: PRISM project validation executed by the AOS workflow engine

steps.title: Build web
steps.purpose: Compile and bundle PRISM's React application
steps.scriptSource:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Compile the exact React bundle served by the PRISM Python service.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../services/prism-service/prism_service/web"
exec npm run build

steps.title: Test
steps.purpose: Run PRISM full validation against the Aspire-served application
steps.scriptSource:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Project validation: exercise PRISM's Python behavior from its service root.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../services/prism-service"
exec uv run pytest -q
